operations.source: app/components/parts-catalogue.tsx; app/components/home-catalogue-preview.tsx; app/components/support-source-picker.tsx; lib/api/support-sources.ts; lib/api/sitemap-server.ts; app/sitemap.xml/route.ts; lib/api/public-seed-server.ts; lib/api/public-seed.ts; lib/api/use-resource.ts
operations.implementation: Public discovery plus complete cursor-paged sitemap scan using public IDs only; sitemap fails with 503 on malformed, repeated or incomplete paging, timeout or backend outage. Validated first page is rendered on the server and passed to the interactive list. Metadata/page reads are deduplicated within a request; hydration skips its immediate duplicate fetch. Filters, cursor paging, reconnect/visibility and public account-change events fetch current data. Failed reads hide stale rendered records, and failed initial collection reads are noindex rather than empty.
operations.verification: Production homepage fixtures passed empty and failed requests, populated recovery, server price, detail destination and mobile overflow; complete catalogue filtering and real media verification pending Isolated production SSR/API fixture verified sitemap later-page IDs, no private credentials, configured origin and failure responses; real catalogue scale/concurrent changes remain unverified. Isolated production Edge/API fixtures verify first-page content without JavaScript, private-field stripping before serialization, inert review text, deduplicated initial reads, filter/page/reset, outage recovery, cross-tab refresh and 320/1280px accessibility/layout. Real API/media, production performance and catalogue concurrency remain unverified.

Complete nullable year bounds are sent together; model-specific searches require a named model. The backend merges partial year bounds with stored values inside the product lock and rejects inverted ranges with 409; database range constraints remain in place.
operations.verification: Production browser fixtures cover CRUD/review, stale projections, unknown outcomes and role/session isolation. The disposable Phase 4 API flow and seven boundary/security cases pass after a 500 reproduction: partial invalid bounds yield 409 without changes, concurrent competing bounds have one winner, null/open-ended bounds and valid patches work, and missing children return 404. Expected-revision atomicity and real hosted image verification remain outstanding.

operations.implementation: Public discovery plus complete cursor-paged sitemap scan using public IDs only; sitemap fails with 503 on malformed, repeated or incomplete paging, timeout or backend outage. Validated first page is rendered on the server and passed to the interactive list. Metadata/page reads are deduplicated within a request; hydration skips its immediate duplicate fetch. Filters, cursor paging, reconnect/visibility and public account-change events fetch current data. Failed reads hide stale rendered records, and failed initial collection reads are noindex rather than empty.
operations.verification: Public list empty/error/retry browser fixtures passed; detail server rendering and booking integration pending Isolated production SSR/API fixture verified sitemap later-page IDs, no private credentials, configured origin and failure responses; real catalogue scale/concurrent changes remain unverified. Isolated production Edge/API fixtures verify first-page content without JavaScript, private-field stripping before serialization, inert review text, deduplicated initial reads, filter/page/reset, outage recovery, cross-tab refresh and 320/1280px accessibility/layout. Real API/media, production performance and catalogue concurrency remain unverified.

operations.implementation: Public projection only, target-type filters, cursor paging and distinct read failure/empty states. Per-product/service query narrowing is not used on this general feedback page; no aggregate rating is inferred. Validated first page is rendered on the server and passed to the interactive list. Metadata/page reads are deduplicated within a request; hydration skips its immediate duplicate fetch. Filters, cursor paging, reconnect/visibility and public account-change events fetch current data. Failed reads hide stale rendered records, and failed initial collection reads are noindex rather than empty. The homepage renders up to three approved reviews using the same public projection, with loading, empty, refresh, failure and recovery states. No anonymous review solicitation is displayed.
operations.verification: Backend routes, schemas, projections, source eligibility and moderation/version policy inspected. Nineteen intercepted production Edge review scenarios passed, including all targets, source revalidation, publication/rejection, stale/unknown writes, role restrictions, private-field exclusion and account isolation. Mobile accessibility/focus and stable dialog capture checked. Real API ownership, uniqueness/concurrency and delivery remain unverified. Isolated production Edge/API fixtures verify first-page content without JavaScript, private-field stripping before serialization, inert review text, deduplicated initial reads, filter/page/reset, outage recovery, cross-tab refresh and 320/1280px accessibility/layout. Real API/media, production performance and catalogue concurrency remain unverified. Three additional production Edge scenarios verified homepage hydration without duplicate reads, public identity stripping and inert text, empty-to-published updates, failed refresh hiding stale feedback, retry and isolated review outage without losing other homepage sections.

operations.cache: All browser API requests use no-store. Account-scoped data must be discarded on session change. Refresh the affected resource after a confirmed mutation; never optimistically confirm money or stock.
operations.implementation: Shared reference overview with five role-appropriate cards, daily activity, booking statuses and bounded recent records. Strict inclusive Lagos date range (1-90 days). Server scopes by customer or active staff branch; only administrators query/receive settled-payment and processed-refund totals. Exact per-currency strings, consistent database snapshot, visibility-aware minute refresh with backoff and no account cache persistence.
operations.verification: Five real disposable API cases passed within a 15-case overview/finance/service regression. All 33 migrations replayed with no schema drift. Final 56-case production browser batch passed, including 12 overview fixture cases, four actual API/proxy role cases, navigation/cart/header regressions and responsive axe/overflow checks at 320/360/390/768/1024/1440/1655. Reference and final desktop/mobile screenshots inspected. All 116 frontend unit tests, type/lint/format and production build passed. Synthetic session fixtures are not credential/MFA enrollment tests; production query-volume timing and real deployment remain unverified.
